$comment: Exact lines that may hold a name the public terminology check refuses, because the file format defines it, because it is an Office.js identifier, or because a third-party license requires it (AGENTS.md, "Naming"). Each entry is a file path and the trimmed line. Add an entry only for a format-defined name (a part path, a content type, an element or attribute value) an Office.js identifier, an npm package name, a font family name that a workbook stores, or a copyright line that a third-party license requires word for word, never for prose. The check fails on an entry that matches nothing.
